content.short: Developer DAO Academy is an open-source education platform created by the Developer DAO, delivering Web3 education through projects.
content.description: Developer DAO Academy is an open-source education platform created by the Developer DAO to teach Web3 concepts through practical projects. Learners work on hands-on tasks such as writing a basic smart contract, minting NFTs, and crafting tests for NFT code. The curriculum also builds foundational skills, including getting started with the command line, choosing and using code editors (IDEs), and working with decentralized storage, then shows how to publish or display NFTs on marketplaces like OpenSea and Rarible.
